changelog:
* **docs: drop Change-Id from commit format in AGENTS.md** (1ec9184)
  - Align AGENTS.md Git section with README: no Change-Id footer or divider, only Signed-off-by.
* **feat: add multi-draft support with Settings management** (2bc79eb)
  - Add drafts table (DraftEntity/DraftDao) with DB v3 migration keeping history intact.
  - Add draft CRUD to SheetRepository (save/load/delete/restore, auto-named Draft #N).
  - Move draft management to Settings: expandable Draft card listing drafts with Save-to-History and Discard actions.
  - Make Calculator back-exit dialog minimal (2 buttons, one line); save-as-draft writes synchronously before exit.
  - Open drafts in Report (fromDraft mode) with Load into Calculator button.
  - Include drafts in backup (v2) and restore; v1 backups still restorable.
  - Update docs/FILES.md per-file reference.
